title: Row actions are Contact and Create work order; menu holds the rest
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions. Raising a work order also needs create and edit work orders.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. A normal row; a Needs readings row (a service watching mileage on an asset with no mileage reading);
  4. a row whose asset's contact has no phone and no email and whose customer has no company phone (e.g. "Depark Paving"), and a row whose contact has nothing but whose customer has a company phone.
custom_steps:
1. Read a normal row's buttons and open its three-dot menu.
  2. Do the same on the Needs readings row.
  3. Look at the Contact button on the "Depark Paving" row and hover it.
  4. Look at the Contact button on the row whose customer has a company phone.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The row shows Contact and Create work order; the menu offers Mark complete, Skip and Open asset.
  • The Needs readings row has the same actions.
  • The Contact button has an orange border and its hover reads "No phone or email on file". (The design's hover reads "Contact · no phone or email on file"; record the build's wording.)
  • The Contact button has no orange border (the company phone is a way to reach the customer).
